text:
Type: light beige curtains, one pair
Use: softening daylight and adding privacy at a window; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: thin semi-sheer woven fabric with a fine linen-like texture, heading tape on the top edge
Colors: light sand beige, warm greige
Shape: two long straight panels hanging in loose soft folds from a rod, plain hem, light and airy drape
Feel: soft, airy, warm, calm
Goes with: white walls, light wood, cream and grey textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: VIVAN
product.description: The curtains let the daylight through but provide privacy so they are perfect to use in a layered window solution.
